# Uncrashable Holdings

> Uncrashable Holdings is the canonical public reference for Continuity Architecture: evaluating whether a family, business, or organization can continue functioning through ordinary disruption, before optimizing its performance.

The pages below are the canonical entry points into the knowledge system, generated from the actual content rather than hand-maintained. Each is the single authoritative definition of its concept; every other mention of the same term elsewhere on the site links back to it rather than redefining it.

## Framework

- [AOIDR](https://uncrashableholdings.com/framework/aoidr): Explains the framework used to examine Invisible Fragility.
- [Authority](https://uncrashableholdings.com/framework/authority): Defines the Authority pillar: whether legitimate decision-making can continue when key people become unavailable.
- [Documentation](https://uncrashableholdings.com/framework/documentation): Defines the Documentation pillar: whether essential knowledge survives the memory of any one person.
- [Income](https://uncrashableholdings.com/framework/income): Defines the Income pillar: whether financial continuity survives interruption instead of depending on a single source.
- [Invisible Fragility](https://uncrashableholdings.com/framework/invisible-fragility): Names the condition Continuity Architecture exists to address.
- [Methodology](https://uncrashableholdings.com/framework/methodology): Explains why the Uncrashable Methodology evaluates continuity before optimization, the principle every framework, assessment, and engagement is built from.
- [Ownership](https://uncrashableholdings.com/framework/ownership): Defines the Ownership pillar: whether legitimate control over people, assets, relationships, and decisions continues when circumstances change.
- [Resilience](https://uncrashableholdings.com/framework/resilience): Defines the Resilience pillar: whether recovery after disruption is structurally designed rather than improvised.

## Diagnostics

- [Continuity Scan](https://uncrashableholdings.com/diagnostics/continuity-scan): Introduces the Continuity Scan as the entry-level diagnostic that reveals whether continuity deserves closer examination, without measuring or diagnosing fragility itself.
- [Continuity Stress Test](https://uncrashableholdings.com/diagnostics/continuity-stress-test): Introduces the Continuity Stress Test as the investigative instrument that examines why fragility exists and how dependencies interact, with no fixed question set.
- [Diagnostics](https://uncrashableholdings.com/diagnostics): Introduces the Uncrashable Diagnostics as one family of assessments and explains how the three levels differ only in depth, not in framework.
- [Invisible Fragility Index](https://uncrashableholdings.com/diagnostics/ifi): Introduces the Invisible Fragility Index as the measurement instrument that produces a structured continuity profile across the five AOIDR pillars.

## Continuity Architecture

- [Continuity Architecture](https://uncrashableholdings.com/continuity-architecture): Explains Continuity Architecture as the engagement that rebuilds a structure's authority, ownership, income, documentation, and resilience once the Invisible Fragility Index or a Continuity Stress Test reveals where it is fragile.

## About

- [About](https://uncrashableholdings.com/about): Names the founder of Uncrashable Holdings, his credentials, and the origin story behind the AOIDR framework.

## Verticals

- [Applications](https://uncrashableholdings.com/verticals/verticals): Explains that Invisible Fragility takes a different shape in each world and routes to each application
- [Athlete Continuity](https://uncrashableholdings.com/verticals/athlete): Applies the framework to earning-window and identity-transition risk for athletes
- [Business Continuity](https://uncrashableholdings.com/verticals/business-owner): Applies the framework to key-person dependence, succession, and operating continuity in privately held businesses
- [Creative Continuity](https://uncrashableholdings.com/verticals/creatives): Applies the framework to rights, catalog, platform dependence, and uneven income for musicians, artists, and other creatives
- [Home Continuity](https://uncrashableholdings.com/verticals/homeowner): Applies the framework to equity, title, debt, and survivor planning for households
- [Nonprofit Continuity](https://uncrashableholdings.com/verticals/nonprofit): Applies the framework to founder dependence, governance, and funding concentration in nonprofits
